regions.merged_text: Well the waited-for coppies have come finally and I am sending the first one to you W. V. Bedolfe and at last thanking for those precious books. I find it a great advantage, to pray to the Holy Ghost - Third Person of the Blessed Trinity before reading them.

regions.merged_text: O Lord Jesus! Blessed God! Teach us appreciation that we may learn something of the first and surest practical indication of intelligence - Gratitude for favors received. According to Pope Pius XII Man's first and gravest duty is just that. Gratitude for favors received.
